equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed or framed; the report describes a small neighborhood cluster of human and canine cases.

notes: Descriptive case series of 4 human and 5 canine cases within an outbreak investigation; statewide and county incidence rates are cited from earlier reports. The statement that no cases occurred in the neighborhood in the preceding 10 years is context, not a computed comparison.
